scope: Frozen experimental joint-budget and variable-length verifier source, portable contracts, tests and technical claims. CPU only; no MLX/Metal import, evaluation or model loading by reviewer.

resolved_findings.title: Fractional remaining budget could exceed requested output bound
resolved_findings.resolution: Exact positive integer validation in greedy_result and VerifyRow constructor plus per-tick/per-verify validation; regression rejects bool, fractional, zero, negative and NaN remaining.

resolved_findings.title: Loose generation and cost dimension types could alias identities
resolved_findings.resolution: Request generation/depth/batch/context require exact integers; nonempty identity strings; bool/non-real probabilities rejected; Confidence takes immutable tuple; portable regression coverage.

reviewed_invariants: Conditional float32 cumulative survival versus already-cumulative values; nonfinite/range validation; unverified suffix remains censored.
N-2 total-work choice and N-1 allocation preserve committed RequestKey(uid,generation) histories and current flat-index ties.
CostKey separates model/draft/quantization/batch/context/strategy/calibration; strategy mismatches reject even forced-length controls; measured complete curves remain caller responsibility.
Actual MLX allocator is dispatched and consumed by session when allocator=mlx and no forced-length override.
Dense verification merges disposable copies; originals commit by exact consumed-prefix replay. Hybrid state remains single-row and uses same exact replay.
Exceptions and cancellation restore both target/draft caches before rethrow; statistics and history only commit after all model work succeeds.
EOS and remaining-budget truncation censor suffixes; slot-generation changes get independent statistics; dynamic order uses stable keys.
Returned model-call submissions and executed token positions are explicitly not GPU kernel counts or comparative speed evidence.
limits: Device execution, numerical equivalence and real-model quality/performance require separate verification evidence.
Experimental session is separate from public continuous worker and does not automatically calibrate cost curves.
Hybrid cross-row batching and trained confidence weights are not implemented or claimed.
No claim of speed advantage follows from eliminating padded positions alone.
